'''Janor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when she was stationed the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Operations Gear Vendor for the Trooper class, Lieutenant Janor was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4 on [[October 1]], [[2013]], along with the other Operations Gear Vendors.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.4.0/dread-war|text=Game Update 2.4: The Dread War Patch Notes}}</ref> He was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, he remains in the game, as his character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
